$comment: Pinned generated texture key per NPC def id. THE source of truth - imported
by src/engine/phaser-bridge/sprite-kind.ts (the game) and served over
/npc-sprites to the Set Piece Editor extension, which is standalone .mjs and
This file exists because the editor kept a private copy of this map and it
went stale: the Goon and Merchant were regenerated to -v3- and the game was
repointed, but the editor still drew the old npc-*-var-0 sprites. Anyone
reviewing the room in the editor was looking at art that had already been
replaced - and screenshots taken from it were quietly wrong.
Values are BARE manifest keys, which preload as individual Phaser textures,
so a caller only needs scene.textures.exists(key) to gate on availability.
Pinned per def id rather than by variant roll because the approved variant
differs per NPC; a roll-derived index would mis-pick every one of them.
tests/unit/npc-sprite-map.test.ts asserts every value is actually present in
the generated manifest, so a pointer at art that was never approved fails.
